name: cinematic documentary
principles: one photographic world dominates the entire deck
condensed display type becomes part of the image
use one warm signal color against restrained dark neutrals
interface details behave like production marks, frame counters, or archival labels
compositionRules: prefer full-bleed media with directional scrims
allow giant numerals and ghost words to exceed conventional columns
alternate dense evidence scenes with sparse emotional scenes
motionRules: text enters in short editorial beats
mediaRules: search for authentic environments, tools, hands, and people at work
